title: Weekly backup report
description: Lists the files in the backups folder (inside the files folder) and compares them with the last run: new, changed and missing files, empty files, and a warning when nothing new has arrived for a week. Writes reports/backup-report.md. Add a schedule under ⋯ > Triggers. Put your backups, or a copy of the list, in the backups folder under ⋯ > Files. Needs nothing else.
name: Weekly backup report

files.backups/README.txt: Put your backups (or a copy of what is in your backup folder) here.
